obligations.source_obligation: The fictional support party may access only the payload-free recovery marker under SHI direction for simulated recovery maintenance; no independent use or disclosure is permitted.
The fictional support party applies scenario role access, encryption, logging and recovery safeguards and supplies SHI reviewable control records.

The fictional support party alerts SHI within 12 scenario-hours after discovering unauthorized marker access, supplies known facts and updates the record; SHI retains the fictional customer-reporting duty.
The fictional support party may delegate marker maintenance only after SHI approval and a further simulated agreement carrying these same restrictions and safeguards.
The fictional support party assists SHI with synthetic customer rights requests within three scenario-business-days of SHI direction.
The fictional support party makes relevant scenario marker records available to SHI for simulated review and to the fictional review authority only through SHI direction.
At simulated support end, the fictional support party returns or destroys the marker within 15 scenario-days where feasible and protects any retained copy until deletion.

SHI may demand cure of a material scenario term failure within five scenario-business-days, suspend support access, or terminate the simulated subcontract; late execution does not cure an earlier route.
